title: Hedgerow component diagram
description: Hedgerow, WWII hex tactics for the browser. The client is a Godot 4 project exported to WebAssembly and started by a small script in the page; its Worker only puts the page behind icelander.net's sign-in and joins the split engine file. Everything else, the rules and the computer opponent included, runs in the browser.

components.name: Hedgerow
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot client, the page's files and the Worker, built by build.mjs and deployed together with wrangler.

components.name: Godot client
components.responsibility: The game itself: the map and its 3D diorama, the pieces, the rules, the computer opponent, the camera and the HUD.

components.name: Page
components.responsibility: web/: boot.js starts the engine behind a loading screen (shell.css); _headers sets the Content-Security-Policy.

components.name: Hedgerow Worker
components.responsibility: worker/index.ts: the page behind icelander.net's sign-in (games:play), the split engine .wasm joined into one file, and every other path as a static asset.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in to icelander.net and their games: roles, asked through a service binding.

relationships.description: Copied into the export by build.mjs.
Starts the Godot engine with the export's configuration.
Service binding ACCOUNTS, through vendor/icelander-auth: who is signed in, on every request for the page.
